# Objetivo

Construir la primera versión del modelo OD-buffers **enriquecido e interanual** usando como base:

- `2024-W17`
- `2025-W17`

Manteniendo la misma metodología del flujo OD-buffers principal y agregando primero:

- `dummy_anio`
- espacio para controles de demanda/oferta

::: {.callout-note}
## Alcance de esta versión
- Se preserva la metodología base del notebook de OD-buffers:
  - unidad de observación = viaje
  - atributos alternativo-específicos `OD × tipo_pago`
  - muestra restringida a OD con las 3 alternativas observadas
  - `leave-one-out` en la alternativa elegida
- `n_trasbordos` se deriva desde `n_etapas_recon - 1`
- En esta primera versión **no** se incorporan aún variables socio-demográficas
- El modelo objetivo inicial sigue siendo **Nested Logit**
:::

## 3) Helpers

```{python}
#| label: helpers
print("label: helpers")
def year_from_partition(partition: str) -> int:
    return int(partition.split("-W")[0])


def build_partition_trip_context(partition: str) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    parquet_path = PARQUET_BY_PARTITION[partition]
    if not parquet_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe parquet final para {partition}: {parquet_path}")

    print(f"\n📦 Partición {partition}")
    print(f"   parquet: {parquet_path}")

    lf = read_parquet_portable(str(parquet_path))

    caract_path = resolve_caracterizacion_path(None, partition)
    df_caract = load_caracterizacion(caract_path)
    print(f"   caracterización: {caract_path}")
    print(f"   usuarios caracterización: {df_caract.height:,}")

    lf_demand = read_parquet_portable(str(parquet_path)).select(
        ["zona_inicio_viaje", "tiempo_inicio_viaje", "tipodia"]
    )
    lf_demand = add_time_dummies_v2(lf_demand)
    df_demand_base = (
        lf_demand.filter(pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").is_not_null())
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("zona_inicio_viaje").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zona_inicio_viaje"),
            pl.when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PM") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PM"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PT") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PT"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_VALLE") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_VALLE"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("NO_LAB"))
            .alias("franja_v2")
        )
        .group_by(["zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"])
        .agg(pl.len().alias("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA_RAW"))
        .collect()
        .with_columns(pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"))
    )
    print(f"   demand base raw: {df_demand_base.height:,} celdas")

    df_od_alt = build_od_alt_specific_context_table(
        lf,
        df_caracterizacion=df_caract,
        config=OD_CONFIG,
    )
    print(f"   OD alt-specific: {df_od_alt.height:,} filas")

    df_trips = build_trip_dataset_with_alt_specific_context(
        lf,
        df_caracterizacion=df_caract,
        df_od_alt_context=df_od_alt,
        time_dummy_variant=OD_CONFIG.time_dummy_variant,
        mean_mode=OD_CONFIG.mean_mode,
        drop_chosen_singletons=True,
    )

    df_trips = df_trips.with_columns(
        [
            pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
            pl.lit(year_from_partition(partition)).alias("year"),
            (pl.lit(year_from_partition(partition)) == 2025).cast(pl.Int8).alias("DUMMY_ANIO_2025"),
        ]
    )

    # Guardrail metodológico explícito.
    if "NTR_BIP" not in df_trips.columns:
        raise ValueError("Falta NTR_BIP en dataset alt-specific; revisar construcción de n_trasbordos.")

    print(f"   trips alt-specific: {df_trips.height:,} filas")
    return df_od_alt, df_trips, df_demand_base


def build_zona777_area_table(zonas777_shp: Path) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if not zonas777_shp.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe shapefile de ZONA777: {zonas777_shp}")
    gdf = gpd.read_file(zonas777_shp)
    return build_zona777_area_table_from_gdf(gdf)


def add_origin_demand_controls(
    df_trips: pl.DataFrame,
    df_demand_base: pl.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    required = {
        "zona_inicio_viaje",
        "partition",
        "DUMMY_LAB_PM",
        "DUMMY_LAB_PT",
        "DUMMY_LAB_VALLE",
        "DUMMY_NO_LAB",
    }
    missing = sorted(required - set(df_trips.columns))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas para construir control de demanda: {missing}")
    required_base = {"partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2", "N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA_RAW"}
    missing_base = sorted(required_base - set(df_demand_base.columns))
    if missing_base:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas en base de demanda: {missing_base}")

    df = (
        df_trips.with_columns(
            pl.when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PM") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PM"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PT") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_PT"))
            .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_VALLE") == 1)
            .then(pl.lit("LAB_VALLE"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("NO_LAB"))
            .alias("franja_v2")
        )
    )

    df = (
        df.join(df_demand_base, on=["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"], how="left")
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA_RAW").fill_null(0) - 1)
            .clip(lower_bound=0)
            .alias("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA").log1p().alias("LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
        )
    )
    df_demand = (
        df_demand_base
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA_RAW") - 1)
            .clip(lower_bound=0)
            .alias("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA").log1p().alias("LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
        )
        .sort(["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"])
    )
    return df, df_demand


def build_stop_zona_modal_crosswalk(
    *,
    partitions: list[str],
    valid_transport_types: set[str],
    ambiguity_threshold: float = 0.80,
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    pieces = []
    for partition in partitions:
        parquet_path = PARQUET_BY_PARTITION[partition]
        lf = read_parquet_portable(str(parquet_path))
        for i in range(1, 7):
            pieces.append(
                lf.select(
                    pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                    pl.col(f"tipo_transporte_{i}").alias("tipo_transporte"),
                    pl.col(f"paradero_subida_{i}").alias("stop"),
                    pl.col(f"zona_subida_{i}").alias("zona"),
                )
            )
            pieces.append(
                lf.select(
                    pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                    pl.col(f"tipo_transporte_{i}").alias("tipo_transporte"),
                    pl.col(f"paradero_bajada_{i}").alias("stop"),
                    pl.col(f"zona_bajada_{i}").alias("zona"),
                )
            )

    df_pairs = (
        pl.concat(pieces, how="vertical_relaxed")
        .filter(
            pl.col("tipo_transporte").is_in(sorted(valid_transport_types))
            & pl.col("stop").is_not_null()
            & (pl.col("stop").str.strip_chars() != "")
            & pl.col("zona").is_not_null()
            & (pl.col("zona").str.strip_chars() != "")
        )
        .collect()
    )

    stop_stats = df_pairs.group_by("stop").agg(
        pl.len().alias("n_obs"),
        pl.n_unique("zona").alias("n_zonas"),
    )
    stop_zone = df_pairs.group_by(["stop", "zona"]).len().rename({"len": "n_obs_zona"})
    crosswalk = (
        stop_zone.sort(["stop", "n_obs_zona", "zona"], descending=[False, True, False])
        .group_by("stop")
        .first()
        .join(stop_stats, on="stop", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("n_obs_zona") / pl.col("n_obs")).alias("modal_share"),
            pl.col("zona").alias("zona_modal"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("modal_share") < ambiguity_threshold).alias("is_ambiguous_for_offer"),
            (pl.col("n_zonas") > 1).alias("has_multiple_zones"),
        )
        .select(
            "stop",
            "zona_modal",
            "n_obs",
            "n_obs_zona",
            "n_zonas",
            "modal_share",
            "has_multiple_zones",
            "is_ambiguous_for_offer",
        )
        .sort(["is_ambiguous_for_offer", "modal_share", "n_obs"], descending=[True, False, True])
    )

    part_stop_zone = df_pairs.group_by(["partition", "stop", "zona"]).len().rename({"len": "n_obs_zona"})
    part_modal = (
        part_stop_zone.sort(["partition", "stop", "n_obs_zona", "zona"], descending=[False, False, True, False])
        .group_by(["partition", "stop"])
        .first()
    )
    part_wide = part_modal.select("partition", "stop", pl.col("zona").alias("zona_modal")).pivot(
        on="partition",
        index="stop",
        values="zona_modal",
    )
    if all(partition in part_wide.columns for partition in partitions):
        same_modal = (
            part_wide.filter(pl.all_horizontal([pl.col(p).is_not_null() for p in partitions]))
            .with_columns((pl.col(partitions[0]) == pl.col(partitions[1])).alias("same_modal_zone"))
        )
        n_both_years = same_modal.height
        pct_same_modal_zone_between_years = float(same_modal["same_modal_zone"].mean()) if same_modal.height else None
    else:
        n_both_years = 0
        pct_same_modal_zone_between_years = None

    summary = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "metric": [
                "n_obs_pairs",
                "n_unique_stops",
                "n_stops_unique_zone",
                "pct_stops_unique_zone",
                "n_stops_modal_share_ge_95",
                "pct_stops_modal_share_ge_95",
                "n_stops_modal_share_lt_80",
                "pct_stops_modal_share_lt_80",
                "n_stops_both_years",
                "pct_same_modal_zone_between_years",
            ],
            "value": [
                float(df_pairs.height),
                float(crosswalk.height),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("n_zonas") == 1).height),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("n_zonas") == 1).height / max(crosswalk.height, 1)),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("modal_share") >= 0.95).height),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("modal_share") >= 0.95).height / max(crosswalk.height, 1)),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("modal_share") < ambiguity_threshold).height),
                float(crosswalk.filter(pl.col("modal_share") < ambiguity_threshold).height / max(crosswalk.height, 1)),
                float(n_both_years),
                pct_same_modal_zone_between_years,
            ],
        },
        schema_overrides={"metric": pl.Utf8, "value": pl.Float64},
    )

    return crosswalk, summary


DAY_COLS = {
    0: "monday",
    1: "tuesday",
    2: "wednesday",
    3: "thursday",
    4: "friday",
    5: "saturday",
    6: "sunday",
}


def week_dates_from_partition(partition: str) -> list[date]:
    year_s, week_s = partition.split("-W")
    year = int(year_s)
    week = int(week_s)
    return [date.fromisocalendar(year, week, d) for d in range(1, 8)]


def yyyymmdd(value: date) -> int:
    return value.year * 10000 + value.month * 100 + value.day


def parse_hms_to_seconds(raw: str | None) -> int | None:
    if raw is None:
        return None
    hh, mm, ss = str(raw).split(":")
    return int(hh) * 3600 + int(mm) * 60 + int(ss)


def station_from_stop_name_for_offer(name: str | None) -> str:
    if name is None:
        return ""
    import re
    import unicodedata

    text = str(name)
    text_ascii = "".join(
        c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text) if unicodedata.category(c) != "Mn"
    )
    base = re.sub(r"(?i)\s*DIRECCION.*$", "", text_ascii).strip()
    base = re.sub(r"(?i)\s+DIR\s+.*$", "", base).strip()
    base = base.replace("(M)", "").replace("(m)", "").strip()
    return normalize_station_name(base)


def active_service_ids_for_date(
    calendar: pl.DataFrame,
    calendar_dates: pl.DataFrame,
    service_date: date,
) -> set[str]:
    day_col = DAY_COLS[service_date.weekday()]
    active = set(
        calendar.filter(
            (pl.col(day_col) == 1)
            & (pl.col("start_date") <= yyyymmdd(service_date))
            & (pl.col("end_date") >= yyyymmdd(service_date))
        )["service_id"].to_list()
    )
    if calendar_dates.height > 0:
        exceptions = calendar_dates.filter(pl.col("date") == yyyymmdd(service_date))
        added = set(exceptions.filter(pl.col("exception_type") == 1)["service_id"].to_list())
        removed = set(exceptions.filter(pl.col("exception_type") == 2)["service_id"].to_list())
        active = (active | added) - removed
    return active


def franja_v2_from_service_date_hour(service_date: date, hour: int) -> str:
    is_laboral = service_date.weekday() < 5
    if is_laboral and hour in HORAS_PUNTA_MANANA:
        return "LAB_PM"
    if is_laboral and hour in HORAS_PUNTA_TARDE:
        return "LAB_PT"
    if is_laboral:
        return "LAB_VALLE"
    return "NO_LAB"


def build_bus_stop_density_by_zone(
    *,
    zona_area: pl.DataFrame,
    bus_crosswalk_offer_ready: pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    ensure_unique_keys(zona_area, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "zona_area")
    df_counts = (
        bus_crosswalk_offer_ready
        .select(
            pl.col("stop"),
            pl.col("zona_modal").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zona_inicio_viaje"),
        )
        .drop_nulls()
        .group_by("zona_inicio_viaje")
        .agg(pl.col("stop").n_unique().alias("N_BUS_STOPS"))
    )
    df_out = (
        zona_area.join(df_counts, on="zona_inicio_viaje", how="left")
        .with_columns(pl.col("N_BUS_STOPS").fill_null(0).cast(pl.Float64))
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("N_BUS_STOPS") / pl.col("AREA_KM2")).fill_nan(0.0).fill_null(0.0).alias("BUS_STOP_DENSITY"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("BUS_STOP_DENSITY").log1p().alias("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY")
        )
        .sort("zona_inicio_viaje")
    )
    ensure_unique_keys(df_out, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "df_bus_infra")
    return df_out


def build_bus_line_count_by_zone_franja(
    *,
    partition: str,
    bus_crosswalk_offer_ready: pl.DataFrame,
    valid_zonas: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    profiles_path = BUS_PROFILES_BY_PARTITION[partition]
    path_str = str(profiles_path)
    lf = read_parquet_portable(path_str).select(
        [
            pl.col("ServicioUsuario").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("bus_line"),
            pl.col("Paradero").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("stop"),
            pl.col("timestamp"),
        ]
    ).drop_nulls(["bus_line", "stop", "timestamp"])

    lf = lf.with_columns(
        pl.col("timestamp").dt.truncate("1h").alias("tiempo_inicio_viaje"),
        pl.when(pl.col("timestamp").dt.weekday().is_in([6, 7]))
        .then(pl.lit(1))
        .otherwise(pl.lit(0))
        .cast(pl.Int8)
        .alias("tipodia"),
    ).drop("timestamp")

    lf = add_time_dummies_v2(lf).with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PM") == 1)
        .then(pl.lit("LAB_PM"))
        .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_PT") == 1)
        .then(pl.lit("LAB_PT"))
        .when(pl.col("DUMMY_LAB_VALLE") == 1)
        .then(pl.lit("LAB_VALLE"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("NO_LAB"))
        .alias("franja_v2")
    )

    df_zone_hour = (
        lf.join(
            bus_crosswalk_offer_ready.lazy().select(
                pl.col("stop"),
                pl.col("zona_modal").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zona_inicio_viaje"),
            ),
            on="stop",
            how="inner",
        )
        .group_by(["zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2", "tiempo_inicio_viaje"])
        .agg(pl.col("bus_line").n_unique().alias("bus_line_count_h"))
        .collect()
    )

    df_out = (
        df_zone_hour.group_by(["zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"])
        .agg(
            pl.len().alias("n_hour_cells"),
            pl.col("bus_line_count_h").mean().alias("BUS_LINE_COUNT"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("BUS_LINE_COUNT").log1p().alias("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"),
            pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
        )
        .sort(["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"])
    )
    if valid_zonas is not None:
        df_out, filter_diag = filter_to_valid_origin_zones(
            df_out,
            valid_zonas,
            f"df_bus_line_count[{partition}]",
        )
        if filter_diag["rows_dropped"] > 0:
            print(f"   filtro zonas BUS_LINE_COUNT {partition}: {filter_diag}")
    ensure_unique_keys(df_out, ["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"], "df_bus_line_count")
    return df_out


def build_metro_station_density_by_zone(
    *,
    zona_area: pl.DataFrame,
    metro_crosswalk_offer_ready: pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    ensure_unique_keys(zona_area, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "zona_area")
    df_counts = (
        metro_crosswalk_offer_ready
        .select(
            pl.col("stop").cast(pl.Utf8).alias("station"),
            pl.col("zona_modal").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zona_inicio_viaje"),
        )
        .drop_nulls()
        .group_by("zona_inicio_viaje")
        .agg(pl.col("station").n_unique().alias("N_METRO_STATIONS"))
    )
    df_out = (
        zona_area.join(df_counts, on="zona_inicio_viaje", how="left")
        .with_columns(pl.col("N_METRO_STATIONS").fill_null(0).cast(pl.Float64))
        .with_columns(
            (pl.col("N_METRO_STATIONS") / pl.col("AREA_KM2")).fill_nan(0.0).fill_null(0.0).alias("METRO_STATION_DENSITY"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("METRO_STATION_DENSITY").log1p().alias("LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY")
        )
        .sort("zona_inicio_viaje")
    )
    ensure_unique_keys(df_out, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "df_metro_infra")
    return df_out


def build_metro_line_count_by_zone_franja(
    *,
    partition: str,
    metro_crosswalk_offer_ready: pl.DataFrame,
    valid_zonas: pl.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    manifest = build_manifest(PROJECT_ROOT / "config" / "GTFS")
    week_dates = week_dates_from_partition(partition)
    version = pick_version_for_date(week_dates[0], manifest)
    if version is None:
        raise ValueError(f"No GTFS version found for partition {partition}")

    gtfs_dir = version.path

    routes = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "routes.txt",
        schema_overrides={"route_id": pl.Utf8, "route_short_name": pl.Utf8, "route_type": pl.Int64},
    ).filter(pl.col("route_type") == 1).with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("route_short_name").is_not_null() & (pl.col("route_short_name").str.len_chars() > 0))
        .then(pl.col("route_short_name"))
        .otherwise(pl.col("route_id"))
        .alias("metro_line")
    )
    metro_route_ids = routes["route_id"].to_list()

    trips_metro = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "trips.txt",
        schema_overrides={
            "route_id": pl.Utf8,
            "trip_id": pl.Utf8,
            "service_id": pl.Utf8,
            "direction_id": pl.Int64,
        },
    ).filter(pl.col("route_id").is_in(metro_route_ids)).join(
        routes.select(["route_id", "metro_line"]),
        on="route_id",
        how="left",
    )

    calendar = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "calendar.txt",
        schema_overrides={
            "service_id": pl.Utf8,
            "monday": pl.Int64,
            "tuesday": pl.Int64,
            "wednesday": pl.Int64,
            "thursday": pl.Int64,
            "friday": pl.Int64,
            "saturday": pl.Int64,
            "sunday": pl.Int64,
            "start_date": pl.Int64,
            "end_date": pl.Int64,
        },
    )
    calendar_dates_path = gtfs_dir / "calendar_dates.txt"
    if calendar_dates_path.exists():
        calendar_dates = pl.read_csv(
            calendar_dates_path,
            schema_overrides={"service_id": pl.Utf8, "date": pl.Int64, "exception_type": pl.Int64},
        )
    else:
        calendar_dates = pl.DataFrame(schema={"service_id": pl.Utf8, "date": pl.Int64, "exception_type": pl.Int64})

    freq = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "frequencies.txt",
        schema_overrides={
            "trip_id": pl.Utf8,
            "start_time": pl.Utf8,
            "end_time": pl.Utf8,
            "headway_secs": pl.Int64,
        },
    ).with_columns(
        pl.col("start_time").map_elements(parse_hms_to_seconds, return_dtype=pl.Int64).alias("start_sec"),
        pl.col("end_time").map_elements(parse_hms_to_seconds, return_dtype=pl.Int64).alias("end_sec"),
    )

    stops = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "stops.txt",
        schema_overrides={"stop_id": pl.Utf8, "stop_name": pl.Utf8, "wheelchair_boarding": pl.Utf8},
        truncate_ragged_lines=True,
    )
    stop_times = pl.read_csv(
        gtfs_dir / "stop_times.txt",
        schema_overrides={"trip_id": pl.Utf8, "stop_id": pl.Utf8, "stop_sequence": pl.Int64},
    )

    station_coverage = (
        stop_times.join(
            trips_metro.select(["trip_id", "route_id", "direction_id", "metro_line"]),
            on="trip_id",
            how="inner",
        )
        .join(stops.select(["stop_id", "stop_name"]), on="stop_id", how="left")
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("stop_name").map_elements(station_from_stop_name_for_offer, return_dtype=pl.Utf8).alias("station_norm")
        )
        .select(["route_id", "direction_id", "metro_line", "station_norm"])
        .filter(pl.col("station_norm").is_not_null() & (pl.col("station_norm") != ""))
        .unique()
    )

    freq_join = freq.join(
        trips_metro.select(["trip_id", "route_id", "metro_line", "service_id", "direction_id"]),
        on="trip_id",
        how="inner",
    ).select(["route_id", "metro_line", "service_id", "direction_id", "start_sec", "end_sec"])

    station_zone = metro_crosswalk_offer_ready.select(
        pl.col("stop").map_elements(station_from_stop_name_for_offer, return_dtype=pl.Utf8).alias("station_norm"),
        pl.col("zona_modal").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).alias("zona_inicio_viaje"),
    ).unique()

    frames = []
    for service_date in week_dates:
        active_service_ids = active_service_ids_for_date(calendar, calendar_dates, service_date)
        if not active_service_ids:
            continue
        freq_active = freq_join.filter(pl.col("service_id").is_in(sorted(active_service_ids)))
        for hour in range(24):
            hour_sec = hour * 3600
            current = freq_active.filter(
                (pl.col("start_sec") <= hour_sec)
                & (pl.col("end_sec") > hour_sec)
            )
            if current.height == 0:
                continue
            franja_v2 = franja_v2_from_service_date_hour(service_date, hour)
            station_hour = (
                current.join(station_coverage, on=["route_id", "direction_id", "metro_line"], how="inner")
                .join(station_zone, on="station_norm", how="inner")
                .group_by("zona_inicio_viaje")
                .agg(pl.col("metro_line").n_unique().alias("metro_line_count_h"))
                .with_columns(
                    pl.lit(partition).alias("partition"),
                    pl.lit(franja_v2).alias("franja_v2"),
                    pl.lit(service_date.isoformat()).alias("service_date"),
                    pl.lit(hour).alias("hour"),
                )
            )
            frames.append(station_hour)

    if not frames:
        return pl.DataFrame(
            schema={
                "zona_inicio_viaje": pl.Int64,
                "partition": pl.Utf8,
                "franja_v2": pl.Utf8,
                "n_hour_cells": pl.UInt32,
                "METRO_LINE_COUNT": pl.Float64,
                "LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT": pl.Float64,
            }
        )

    df_hour = pl.concat(frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
    df_out = (
        df_hour.group_by(["zona_inicio_viaje", "partition", "franja_v2"])
        .agg(
            pl.len().alias("n_hour_cells"),
            pl.col("metro_line_count_h").mean().alias("METRO_LINE_COUNT"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            pl.col("METRO_LINE_COUNT").log1p().alias("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT")
        )
        .sort(["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"])
    )
    if valid_zonas is not None:
        df_out, filter_diag = filter_to_valid_origin_zones(
            df_out,
            valid_zonas,
            f"df_metro_line_count[{partition}]",
        )
        if filter_diag["rows_dropped"] > 0:
            print(f"   filtro zonas METRO_LINE_COUNT {partition}: {filter_diag}")
    ensure_unique_keys(df_out, ["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"], "df_metro_line_count")
    return df_out


def add_origin_offer_controls(
    df_trips: pl.DataFrame,
    df_bus_infra: pl.DataFrame,
    df_metro_infra: pl.DataFrame,
    df_bus_line_count: pl.DataFrame,
    df_metro_line_count: pl.DataFrame,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    required = {"partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"}
    missing = sorted(required - set(df_trips.columns))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas para join de oferta: {missing}")

    keys = ["partition", "zona_inicio_viaje", "franja_v2"]
    ensure_unique_keys(df_bus_infra, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "df_bus_infra")
    ensure_unique_keys(df_metro_infra, ["zona_inicio_viaje"], "df_metro_infra")
    ensure_unique_keys(df_bus_line_count, keys, "df_bus_line_count")
    ensure_unique_keys(df_metro_line_count, keys, "df_metro_line_count")
    before_rows = df_trips.height
    df = (
        df_trips.join(
            df_bus_infra.select(["zona_inicio_viaje", "N_BUS_STOPS", "BUS_STOP_DENSITY", "LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY"]),
            on="zona_inicio_viaje",
            how="left",
        )
        .join(
            df_metro_infra.select(["zona_inicio_viaje", "N_METRO_STATIONS", "METRO_STATION_DENSITY", "LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY"]),
            on="zona_inicio_viaje",
            how="left",
        )
        .join(
            df_bus_line_count.select(keys + ["BUS_LINE_COUNT", "LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT"]),
            on=keys,
            how="left",
        )
        .join(
            df_metro_line_count.select(keys + ["METRO_LINE_COUNT", "LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT"]),
            on=keys,
            how="left",
        )
    )
    assert_left_join_preserves_rows(before_rows, df.height, "join de oferta sobre trips_context pooled")
    ensure_columns_non_null(
        df,
        [
            "N_BUS_STOPS",
            "BUS_STOP_DENSITY",
            "LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY",
            "N_METRO_STATIONS",
            "METRO_STATION_DENSITY",
            "LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY",
        ],
        "join de infraestructura zonal",
    )
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.col("N_BUS_STOPS").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("BUS_STOP_DENSITY").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("N_METRO_STATIONS").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("METRO_STATION_DENSITY").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("BUS_LINE_COUNT").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("METRO_LINE_COUNT").fill_null(0.0),
        pl.col("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT").fill_null(0.0),
    )
    return df


def stratified_sample_partition_choice(
    df: pl.DataFrame,
    *,
    fraction: float | None,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> pl.DataFrame:
    if fraction is None:
        return df
    if not (0 < fraction <= 1):
        raise ValueError(f"SAMPLE_FRACTION_ESTIMATION debe estar en (0,1], recibido: {fraction}")

    sampled = (
        df.group_by("partition", "choice_nested", maintain_order=True)
        .map_groups(lambda g: g.sample(fraction=fraction, shuffle=True, seed=seed))
        .sort(["partition", "choice_nested"])
    )
    return sampled


def remove_biogeme_iter_file(model_name: str, project_root: Path) -> None:
    candidates = [
        project_root / f"{model_name}.iter",
        project_root / f"__{model_name}.iter",
        Path.cwd() / f"{model_name}.iter",
        Path.cwd() / f"__{model_name}.iter",
    ]
    seen = set()
    for iter_path in candidates:
        if iter_path in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(iter_path)
        if iter_path.exists():
            iter_path.unlink()
            print(f"🗑️ Iter eliminado: {iter_path}")


def estimate_nested_option1_alt_specific_enriched(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    model_name: str,
    clean_run_no_iter: bool = False,
    project_root: Path | None = None,
    quick: bool = False,
    include_bus_offer: bool = True,
    include_metro_offer: bool = True,
):
    database = db.Database(model_name, pandas_df)

    CHOICE_BIP = 0
    CHOICE_QR_RED = 1
    CHOICE_QR_OTHER = 2

    CHOICE = Variable("choice_nested")

    LAB_PM = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PM")
    LAB_PT = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PT")
    NO_LAB = Variable("DUMMY_NO_LAB")
    DUMMY_ANIO_2025 = Variable("DUMMY_ANIO_2025")
    LOG_DEMAND = Variable("LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
    LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Variable("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY")
    LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Variable("LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY")
    LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT")
    LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT")

    TVH_BIP = Variable("TVH_BIP")
    TVH_QR_RED = Variable("TVH_QR_RED")
    TVH_QR_OTHER = Variable("TVH_QR_OTHER")

    TEI_BIP = Variable("TEI_BIP")
    TEI_QR_RED = Variable("TEI_QR_RED")
    TEI_QR_OTHER = Variable("TEI_QR_OTHER")

    TET_BIP = Variable("TET_BIP")
    TET_QR_RED = Variable("TET_QR_RED")
    TET_QR_OTHER = Variable("TET_QR_OTHER")

    NTR_BIP = Variable("NTR_BIP")
    NTR_QR_RED = Variable("NTR_QR_RED")
    NTR_QR_OTHER = Variable("NTR_QR_OTHER")

    MU_QR = Beta(f"MU_QR_{partition}", 1.5, 1, 100, 0)
    nest_bip = nests.OneNestForNestedLogit(1.0, [CHOICE_BIP], name="BIP")
    nest_qr = nests.OneNestForNestedLogit(MU_QR, [CHOICE_QR_RED, CHOICE_QR_OTHER], name="QR")
    NESTS = nests.NestsForNestedLogit(
        choice_set=[CHOICE_BIP, CHOICE_QR_RED, CHOICE_QR_OTHER],
        tuple_of_nests=(nest_bip, nest_qr),
    )

    ASC_QR_RED = Beta(f"ASC_QR_RED_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    ASC_QR_OTHER = Beta(f"ASC_QR_OTHER_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_QR_RED_LAB_PM = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PM_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LAB_PT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_NO_LAB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_NO_LAB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_BIP_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    V_BIP = (
        B_BIP_T_VEH * TVH_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_BIP
        + B_BIP_N_TRASB * NTR_BIP
    )
    V_QR_RED = (
        ASC_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_RED_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_RED_T_VEH * TVH_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_RED
    )
    if include_bus_offer:
        V_QR_RED += (
            B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
            + B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        )
    if include_metro_offer:
        V_QR_RED += (
            B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
            + B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        )
    V_QR_OTHER = (
        ASC_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH * TVH_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_OTHER
    )
    if include_bus_offer:
        V_QR_OTHER += (
            B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
            + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
        )
    if include_metro_offer:
        V_QR_OTHER += (
            B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
            + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT
        )

    V = {CHOICE_BIP: V_BIP, CHOICE_QR_RED: V_QR_RED, CHOICE_QR_OTHER: V_QR_OTHER}
    logprob = models.lognested(V, None, NESTS, CHOICE)

    if clean_run_no_iter and project_root is not None:
        remove_biogeme_iter_file(model_name, project_root)

    biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
    biogeme.model_name = model_name
    if BIOGEME_LARGE_RUN_MODE:
        try:
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_html", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_yaml", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("save_iterations", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("number_of_threads", BIOGEME_THREADS)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("calculating_second_derivatives", BIOGEME_SECOND_DERIVATIVES)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("optimization_algorithm", BIOGEME_OPTIMIZATION_ALGORITHM)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if quick:
        results = biogeme.quick_estimate()
    else:
        results = biogeme.estimate()

    stats = results.get_general_statistics()
    params = br.get_pandas_estimated_parameters(results)
    return stats, params


def estimate_mnl_option1_alt_specific_enriched(
    pandas_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    partition: str,
    model_name: str,
    clean_run_no_iter: bool = False,
    project_root: Path | None = None,
    include_bus_offer: bool = True,
    include_metro_offer: bool = True,
    include_bus_stop_density: bool | None = None,
    include_bus_line_count: bool | None = None,
    include_metro_station_density: bool | None = None,
    include_metro_line_count: bool | None = None,
):
    database = db.Database(model_name, pandas_df)

    if include_bus_stop_density is None:
        include_bus_stop_density = include_bus_offer
    if include_bus_line_count is None:
        include_bus_line_count = include_bus_offer
    if include_metro_station_density is None:
        include_metro_station_density = include_metro_offer
    if include_metro_line_count is None:
        include_metro_line_count = include_metro_offer

    CHOICE_BIP = 0
    CHOICE_QR_RED = 1
    CHOICE_QR_OTHER = 2

    CHOICE = Variable("choice_nested")

    LAB_PM = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PM")
    LAB_PT = Variable("DUMMY_LAB_PT")
    NO_LAB = Variable("DUMMY_NO_LAB")
    DUMMY_ANIO_2025 = Variable("DUMMY_ANIO_2025")
    LOG_DEMAND = Variable("LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA")
    LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Variable("LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY")
    LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Variable("LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY")
    LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT")
    LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Variable("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT")

    TVH_BIP = Variable("TVH_BIP")
    TVH_QR_RED = Variable("TVH_QR_RED")
    TVH_QR_OTHER = Variable("TVH_QR_OTHER")

    TEI_BIP = Variable("TEI_BIP")
    TEI_QR_RED = Variable("TEI_QR_RED")
    TEI_QR_OTHER = Variable("TEI_QR_OTHER")

    TET_BIP = Variable("TET_BIP")
    TET_QR_RED = Variable("TET_QR_RED")
    TET_QR_OTHER = Variable("TET_QR_OTHER")

    NTR_BIP = Variable("NTR_BIP")
    NTR_QR_RED = Variable("NTR_QR_RED")
    NTR_QR_OTHER = Variable("NTR_QR_OTHER")

    ASC_QR_RED = Beta(f"ASC_QR_RED_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    ASC_QR_OTHER = Beta(f"ASC_QR_OTHER_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_QR_RED_LAB_PM = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PM_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LAB_PT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LAB_PT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_NO_LAB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_NO_LAB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    B_BIP_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_BIP_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_RED_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_RED_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)
    B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB = Beta(f"B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB_{partition}", 0, None, None, 0)

    V_BIP = (
        B_BIP_T_VEH * TVH_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_BIP
        + B_BIP_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_BIP
        + B_BIP_N_TRASB * NTR_BIP
    )
    V_QR_RED = (
        ASC_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_RED_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_RED_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_RED_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_RED_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_RED_T_VEH * TVH_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_RED
        + B_QR_RED_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_RED
    )
    if include_bus_stop_density:
        V_QR_RED += B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
    if include_bus_line_count:
        V_QR_RED += B_QR_RED_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
    if include_metro_station_density:
        V_QR_RED += B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
    if include_metro_line_count:
        V_QR_RED += B_QR_RED_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT

    V_QR_OTHER = (
        ASC_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PM * LAB_PM
        + B_QR_OTHER_LAB_PT * LAB_PT
        + B_QR_OTHER_NO_LAB * NO_LAB
        + B_QR_OTHER_ANIO_2025 * DUMMY_ANIO_2025
        + B_QR_OTHER_LOG_DEMAND * LOG_DEMAND
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_VEH * TVH_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_INI * TEI_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_T_ESPERA_TRASB * TET_QR_OTHER
        + B_QR_OTHER_N_TRASB * NTR_QR_OTHER
    )
    if include_bus_stop_density:
        V_QR_OTHER += B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY * LOG_BUS_STOP_DENSITY
    if include_bus_line_count:
        V_QR_OTHER += B_QR_OTHER_LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT * LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT
    if include_metro_station_density:
        V_QR_OTHER += B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY * LOG_METRO_STATION_DENSITY
    if include_metro_line_count:
        V_QR_OTHER += B_QR_OTHER_LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT * LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT

    V = {CHOICE_BIP: V_BIP, CHOICE_QR_RED: V_QR_RED, CHOICE_QR_OTHER: V_QR_OTHER}
    av = {CHOICE_BIP: 1, CHOICE_QR_RED: 1, CHOICE_QR_OTHER: 1}
    logprob = models.loglogit(V, av, CHOICE)

    if clean_run_no_iter and project_root is not None:
        remove_biogeme_iter_file(model_name, project_root)

    biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
    biogeme.model_name = model_name
    if BIOGEME_LARGE_RUN_MODE:
        try:
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_html", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("generate_yaml", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("save_iterations", False)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("number_of_threads", BIOGEME_THREADS)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("calculating_second_derivatives", BIOGEME_SECOND_DERIVATIVES)
            biogeme.biogeme_parameters.set_value("optimization_algorithm", BIOGEME_OPTIMIZATION_ALGORITHM)
        except Exception:
            pass
    results = biogeme.estimate()

    stats = results.get_general_statistics()
    params = br.get_pandas_estimated_parameters(results)
    return stats, params


MODEL_NUMERIC_COLUMNS = [
    "choice_nested",

    "LOG_N_VIAJES_ZONA_INICIO_FRANJA",

    "TEI_QR_RED",

    "TET_BIP",
    "TET_QR_RED",

    "NTR_BIP",

]


def to_biogeme_numeric_df(df: pl.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    missing = [c for c in MODEL_NUMERIC_COLUMNS if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas requeridas para Biogeme: {missing}")
    return (
        df.select([pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64) for c in MODEL_NUMERIC_COLUMNS])
        .to_pandas()
    )


def display_param_subset(df_params: pd.DataFrame, preferred: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cols = [c for c in preferred if c in df_params.columns]
    if not cols:
        return df_params.head(12)
    return df_params[cols].head(12)


def load_biogeme_numeric_df_from_parquet(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return (
        read_parquet_portable(str(path))
        .select([pl.col(c).cast(pl.Float64) for c in MODEL_NUMERIC_COLUMNS])
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

    return [f"{name}_{MODEL_PARTITION}" for name in names]

def biogeme_stats_to_frame(stats: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "metric": key,
                "value": val[0] if isinstance(val, tuple) else val,
            }
            for key, val in stats.items()
        ]
    )


def write_biogeme_result_csvs(
    *,
    params_df: pd.DataFrame,
    stats: dict,
    params_path: Path,
    stats_path: Path,
) -> None:
    params_df.to_csv(params_path, index=False)
    biogeme_stats_to_frame(stats).to_csv(stats_path, index=False)


def load_biogeme_result_csvs(
    *,
    params_path: Path,
    stats_path: Path,
) -> tuple[dict | None, pd.DataFrame | None]:
    if not (params_path.exists() and stats_path.exists()):
        return None, None
    params_df = pd.read_csv(params_path)
    stats_df = pd.read_csv(stats_path)
    stats = dict(zip(stats_df["metric"], stats_df["value"]))
    return stats, params_df
```

## 9) Conteo de líneas bus por zona y franja

```{python}
#| label: build-bus-line-count-context
print("label: build-bus-line-count-context")
bus_line_frames = []
for partition in PARTITIONS:
    df_bus_line_partition = build_bus_line_count_by_zone_franja(
        partition=partition,
        bus_crosswalk_offer_ready=df_bus_crosswalk.filter(~pl.col("is_ambiguous_for_offer")),
        valid_zonas=df_zona_area.select(["zona_inicio_viaje"]),
    )
    bus_line_frames.append(df_bus_line_partition)

df_bus_line_count_pooled = pl.concat(bus_line_frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
df_bus_line_count_pooled.write_parquet(OUT_BUS_LINE_COUNT_CONTEXT)

print(f"✅ BUS_LINE_COUNT pooled escrito en: {OUT_BUS_LINE_COUNT_CONTEXT}")
display(
    df_bus_line_count_pooled.group_by(["partition", "franja_v2"]).agg(
        pl.len().alias("n_zona_franja_cells"),
        pl.col("BUS_LINE_COUNT").mean().alias("bus_line_count_mean"),
        pl.col("LOG_BUS_LINE_COUNT").mean().alias("log_bus_line_count_mean"),
    ).sort(["partition", "franja_v2"])
)
```

## 10) Conteo de líneas Metro por zona y franja

```{python}
#| label: build-metro-line-count-context
print("label: build-metro-line-count-context")
metro_line_frames = []
for partition in PARTITIONS:
    df_metro_line_partition = build_metro_line_count_by_zone_franja(
        partition=partition,
        metro_crosswalk_offer_ready=df_metro_crosswalk,
        valid_zonas=df_zona_area.select(["zona_inicio_viaje"]),
    )
    metro_line_frames.append(df_metro_line_partition)

df_metro_line_count_pooled = pl.concat(metro_line_frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
df_metro_line_count_pooled.write_parquet(OUT_METRO_LINE_COUNT_CONTEXT)

print(f"✅ METRO_LINE_COUNT pooled escrito en: {OUT_METRO_LINE_COUNT_CONTEXT}")

        pl.col("LOG_METRO_LINE_COUNT").mean().alias("log_metro_line_count_mean"),
    ).sort(["partition", "franja_v2"])
)
```

## 11) Construcción pooled 2024 + 2025

```{python}
#| label: build-pooled-context
print("label: build-pooled-context")
od_frames = []
trip_frames = []
demand_frames = []

for partition in PARTITIONS:
    df_od_alt, df_trips, df_demand_base = build_partition_trip_context(partition)
    od_frames.append(df_od_alt.with_columns(pl.lit(partition).alias("partition")))
    trip_frames.append(df_trips)
    demand_frames.append(df_demand_base)
    gc.collect()

df_od_pooled = pl.concat(od_frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
df_trips_pooled = pl.concat(trip_frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
df_demand_base_pooled = pl.concat(demand_frames, how="diagonal_relaxed")
valid_origin_zonas = df_zona_area.select(["zona_inicio_viaje"])
df_trips_pooled, trips_zone_filter_diag = filter_to_valid_origin_zones(
    df_trips_pooled,
    valid_origin_zonas,
    "df_trips_pooled",
)
df_demand_base_pooled, demand_zone_filter_diag = filter_to_valid_origin_zones(
    df_demand_base_pooled,
    valid_origin_zonas,
    "df_demand_base_pooled",
)
print(f"   filtro zonas trips  : {trips_zone_filter_diag}")
print(f"   filtro zonas demand : {demand_zone_filter_diag}")
df_trips_pooled, df_demand_pooled = add_origin_demand_controls(df_trips_pooled, df_demand_base_pooled)
df_trips_pooled = add_origin_offer_controls(
    df_trips_pooled,
    df_bus_infra,
    df_metro_infra,
    df_bus_line_count_pooled,
    df_metro_line_count_pooled,
)

df_od_pooled.write_parquet(OUT_OD_CONTEXT)
df_trips_pooled.write_parquet(OUT_TRIPS_CONTEXT)

print(f"\n✅ od_context pooled escrito en: {OUT_OD_CONTEXT}")
print(f"✅ trips_context pooled escrito en: {OUT_TRIPS_CONTEXT}")
print(f"   od rows   : {df_od_pooled.height:,}")
print(f"   trip rows : {df_trips_pooled.height:,}")
print(f"   demand cells : {df_demand_pooled.height:,}")
```

```{python}
#| label: release-estimation-memory
print("label: release-estimation-memory")
for name in [
    "df_smoke",
    "df_smoke_pd",
    "df_trips_est",
    "df_od_pooled",
    "df_trips_pooled",
    "df_demand_base_pooled",
    "df_demand_pooled",
    "od_frames",
    "trip_frames",
    "demand_frames",
]:
    if name in globals():
        del globals()[name]
gc.collect()
print("✅ Memoria liberada antes de la estimación full; los modelos cargarán la muestra desde parquet.")
```

```{python}
#| label: compare-nested-vs-mnl
print("label: compare-nested-vs-mnl")
compare_rows = []
for model_label, stats_obj in [
    ("nested", stats_nested),
    ("mnl", stats_mnl),
]:
    row = {"model": model_label}
    for key in [
        "Final log likelihood",
        "Rho-square for the init. model",
        "Rho-square-bar for the init. model",
        "Akaike Information Criterion",
        "Bayesian Information Criterion",
    ]:
        val = stats_obj.get(key)
        row[key] = val[0] if isinstance(val, tuple) else val
    compare_rows.append(row)

display(pl.DataFrame(compare_rows))
```
